Supported content bounds are title 1–60 characters, details 1–240 characters, and button label 1–40 characters across `en-US`, `de-DE`, and `ar-EG`. Page zoom is 100–200%. Layout tokens are `space-16=16px`, `space-24=24px`, and `control-min=44px`.

Relevant constraints at `CheckoutSummary.css:4-31`: `.summary{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(100%,720px);padding:16px;display:grid;gap:16px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}`; children use `min-width:0`; `#pay{width:100%;min-height:44px;white-space:normal}`; there are no fixed, absolute, sticky, negative-margin, overflow-hidden, or order declarations.
